setup.blind_to: Pile rows only; the fixed arm holds the levels a, not g (the state's Gamma sets g), so share reads a fixed choice of a, not a fixed removed fraction; for the least-squares state Delta' differs; the strong adversary is still sign steps of 0.1 with one source per matrix (no step decay, no per-row sources), so M is a lower bound on the true maximum; two models only in the strong stage
setup.expected_at_W0: fixed: F_w0lv = F_own = 0.660 (the same sources), Y = X = 0. strong: F20 = 0.660, alive_whole at 0 steps = 1.075 (amendment 1's F_rest); M >= 1.075 if sign steps from there do not fall
setup.fixed: stage amend2_fixed: W0's saved levels a (results/large/sources/W0.pt, amendment 1's 20-step seed-0 adversary) for every block at W0 and each of the eight states, F_w0lv; and the state's own saved levels, F_own. X = F_own(s) - F_own(W0) (amendment 1's excess), Y = F_w0lv(s) - F_w0lv(W0), share = Y / X
setup.fixed_reading: per state with X > 0: share >= 0.5 -> 2 (the same mask costs more: the model changed); share <= 0.2 -> 1 (the state's adversary found a different mask); between -> both in part
setup.noise: the fixed stage is deterministic (no search): fp32 summation order, about 1e-7 nats (amendment 1's G2); the strong stage's search noise is read from the spread of seed0, seed1, seed2 at 20 steps (E11 seed floor f = 0.075, about 0.05 nats at W0)
setup.rows: the first 128 Pile val rows in batches of 8, every KL fp32 (cancel.masked_kl: KL(model || model masked by g + (1 - g) a over all C subcomponents, Delta' under a_Delta), g always the model's own Gamma)
setup.strong: stage amend2_strong at W0 and ct r1_t534_v369: gamma.pgd_sources (sign steps of 0.1, one source per matrix) in four runs, fp32 KL read at cumulative checkpoints: {"seed0": [20, 50, 100], "alive_whole": [0, 20, 50], "seed1": [20], "seed2": [20]}; seed0, seed1, seed2 from the seed's random draw; alive_whole from the model's saved 20-step levels with every alive level set to 1 (cancel.alive_whole). M = the largest KL over every checkpoint of >= 20 steps of every run; M_random the same over the random-start runs; F20 = seed0 at 20 steps (amendment 1's adversary). X20 = F20(r1 t534) - F20(W0); X_strong = M(r1 t534) - M(W0)
